chunks: And it is narrated: “Whoever deliberately goes to a crucified person and looks at him, ghusl (ritual bath) becomes obligatory upon him as a punishment.”

key_terms.عُقُوبَةً: as a punishment or punitive measure
key_terms.قَصَدَ: intentionally went or directed oneself toward

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on intentionally looking at a crucified person in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling concerning one who intentionally goes to look at a crucified person. It states that ghusl (ritual bath) becomes obligatory upon such a person as a punitive measure.
